patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Workflow advantage: Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management; Tiendanube leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management vs Tiendanube-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Salesforce Commerce Cloud if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
